name: JIS — Japanese Industrial Standards for Construction
description: Validates BOQ items and specifications against key JIS (Japanese Industrial Standards) for construction materials and methods. Covers JIS A 5308 (ready-mixed concrete), JIS G 3112 (reinforcing steel bars), JIS A 6901 (gypsum boards), JIS A 5430 (fibre cement boards), and related material standards. Checks that specification clauses cite the applicable JIS number and that material grades match the JIS classification.
planned_not_built_note: Planned, not built. The engine defines none of the ids in planned_not_built_rule_ids, so switching this document on does not run them. They record what this document is meant to check once the rules are written; move an id back to enables_rule_ids on the day its rule lands, not before.
